fact: LISGIS enumerated the 2022 Liberia Population and Housing Census, the fifth and first fully digital one, with census night on 11 November 2022 and a total enumerated population of 5,250,187.

LISGIS published the final results of the 2022 Liberia Population and Housing Census (preliminary results had been released in February 2023); the document gives June 2023 for its map and is published 2023-06-01.
LISGIS released preliminary results of the 2022 census in February 2023.
The document cites the LISGIS 2022 census for the under-20 population share.
The World Bank's World Development Indicators list the Demographic and Health Survey 2019-2020 as Liberia's latest demographic, education or health household survey, year 2020.
The World Bank's World Development Indicators give an expenditure survey/budget survey of 2014 as the source of Liberia's most recent income and expenditure data.
